Ahmedabad hosts first international para archery event with Indian athletes competing

Ahmedabad is hosting India's first international para archery event, the World Archery Para Series. The event features over 100 athletes. Indian para-archer Sheetal Devi is headlining the national challenge, alongside Harvinder Singh. Devi expressed delight at India hosting the series for the first time.
